description: Reopen r-sort-3-keys-mdb (MDB) read-only. On table-type recordsets, reading NoMatch and the current ID after each Seek: LK by IX_KN with (K, 1) and (K, 2) under "=" and the K-only key under ">=" for every long K value; LK by IX_KND with (K, 1) and (K, 2) under "="; FR by IX_FKN with "=" for each K and N combination including Null and for each K alone; FR by IX_FNK with "=" for each N and three K values. Asks whether two keys with a shared long prefix and different tails are distinguished by Seek, and how Null, empty and partial keys select rows.
